frank.delta: Keep the V2 gwt_loop_controller proposal-only boundary, but make residual estimator identity/version, uncertainty and freshness explicit inputs. Uncertain or stale loop-state readouts must route/escalate rather than mint HALT_CANDIDATE_CONVERGED.

gwt.delta: Recurrence-control readouts require estimator identity/version, uncertainty and observation age at the decision point. A recurrence policy is only as trustworthy as the readout it consumes.

harness.delta: Added loop_dynamics_quality_gate.py plus unit/property validation. 9/9 unit tests and 100000 randomized invariant checks passed in local container proxy; no H1 release credit is awarded.

claycode.delta: If H1 Golden Traces validate the quality-gated loop contract, ClayCode must represent estimator/version/uncertainty/freshness and proposal-only recurrence receipts. Do not redesign semantics before H1 evidence requires it.

unifieddb.delta: Replayable loop decisions should bind readout epoch plus estimator/version/uncertainty/freshness metadata. This does not justify a new physical store.

claygraph.delta: Readout quality metadata is observation provenance/validity, not graph activation, relevance or truth promotion.

hyperposition.delta: When recurrence readout quality is insufficient, preserve/reopen alternative routes instead of collapsing the trajectory into a convergence claim.

emergenz.delta: Noisy/stale measurement can create false controller conclusions and is therefore a confound/intervention candidate in recurrence and emergence-control studies; matched observation-quality controls belong in causal experiments.

clayresearch.delta: The visual-learning law confidence/familiarity != evidence transfers structurally to recurrence: residual score != validated convergence evidence. Both require calibration/version/freshness/provenance before consequential routing.
